recognize_zh: 網狀纖維染色（reticulin）中，左側與中央區域有大量粗細不一、交織成網並有局部粗纖維束的黑色纖維（相當於 MF-2 至 MF-3），對應肥大細胞浸潤區；右側殘存的正常骨髓則只有稀疏的細纖維。以同一視野比較病灶區與正常區，是判讀纖維化分級的關鍵。
features: Dense, diffuse network of intersecting black reticulin fibers with focal thick bundles in the lesional area (left and center)
Fibers run in parallel streaming arrays around spindled infiltrate cells
Adjacent residual marrow (right) with only sparse fine reticulin fibers
Bony trabecula and vessel wall at the edges for orientation
Grade approximately MF-2 to MF-3 in the infiltrate versus MF-0/1 in residual marrow
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section stained for reticulin shows a lesional area with a dense, diffuse network of intersecting reticulin fibers with focal coarse bundles, corresponding to MF-2 to MF-3 fibrosis. The fibers stream around spindled cells of the infiltrate. The adjacent residual hematopoietic marrow on the right shows only sparse fine fibers, within normal limits. Findings are consistent with marked reticulin fibrosis associated with a mast cell infiltrate in systemic mastocytosis; the stated 400x objective appears higher than the actual magnification of this image.

ddx.vs: PMF fibrosis is diffuse and accompanied by clustered atypical megakaryocytes, whereas mastocytosis fibrosis is focal and confined to tryptase/CD117-positive spindle cell aggregates.
HCL shows diffuse fine reticulin fibrosis around evenly spaced fried-egg lymphoid cells that are CD20/annexin A1/BRAF V600E-positive.
Metastatic tumor produces focal fibrosis around cohesive keratin-positive epithelial nests rather than spindled mast cells.
Reparative fibrosis contains granulation tissue, new bone and hemosiderin without a neoplastic infiltrate.
